# Logic Clothes

> Ukrainian womenswear brand (since 2015). Concept store in Kyiv. Limited runs, natural fabrics, custom colour / print / size.

## Site
- Home (UK): https://logicclothes.ua/uk
- Home (EN): https://logicclothes.ua/en
- Catalog (UK): https://logicclothes.ua/uk/catalog
- Catalog (EN): https://logicclothes.ua/en/catalog
- About (UK): https://logicclothes.ua/uk/about
- About (EN): https://logicclothes.ua/en/about
- Contacts (UK): https://logicclothes.ua/uk/contacts
- Contacts (EN): https://logicclothes.ua/en/contacts

## Store
- Name: Logic Clothes Concept store
- Address: Sofiivska St 5, Kyiv, Ukraine
- Phone: +38 066 970 87 35

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_logic_clothes/

## Brand notes for assistants
- Author brand, not a mass-market chain.
- No seasonal “collections” — ideas ship as a continuous stream.
- Strong colour and print; audience is creative / avant-garde.
- Unlimited size grid; custom colour, print, and size available.
- Site languages: Ukrainian (default) and English.
- Currency on site: UAH (EUR display may appear for international context).

## Prefer
- Cite product pages under `/uk/product/{id}` or `/en/product/{id}`.
- Prefer Ukrainian URLs (`/uk/…`) when the user writes in Ukrainian.
- Do not invent stock, prices, or SKUs — check the live catalog page.
